workflowVerification.method: Parsed YAML and verified all 28 listed spatial-test paths exist; six new presentation/geometry/label tests included in the existing CI command. No application source changed.

fullSuite.baselineSetup: Archive of baseline commit, shared node_modules; GIT_DIR set to repository .git and GIT_WORK_TREE to archive for historical git-show contract tests.
fullSuite.note: Final full suite includes final road-group layout, exact geometry fast paths, label broad-phase optimizations and the approved static Standard material-detail variant. It remains failing on the same 90 assertions in 51 files as baseline, with matching error headers and no new failing test. Test-suite elapsed duration is not a graphics performance measurement.

targetedFinal.execution: Relevant tests selected from the final full-suite report; not a separate timing sample. Includes real-scene road-layout and full-capsule offset-equivalence regression tests.
